patch.value: Tracked dist output predates the merged daily-release source changes, so the first post-merge release pack step fails

The resumed-release heading branch changed daily-release.ts (the calendar-day heading helpers) without rebuilding the tracked dist/ output, and merging main carried main's dist forward. No PR-branch gate enforces dist parity: CI and the quick release gate rebuild before running tests and never compare against the committed build. The daily-release workflow's 'Pack verified release' step enforces parity only on main's release candidate, via git diff --exit-code -- . and the dist/ porcelain check after the release's own release:check build, so the first daily release after this merge would fail there until dist is rebuilt and committed.
